io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.networks

Class NetworkManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.networks.NetworkManager

  • public class NetworkManager
extends java.lang.Object
    The NetworkManager is responsible for holding all instances of Network and providing some utility methods that would have probably been static otherwise.
    See Also:
    Network, NetworkListener
